Supreme Court of the United States 
No. 26A382 
SAMUEL STRULOVITCH, ET AL., 
        A p p l i c a n t s 
v. 
MOSHE BAIN, ET AL. 
O R D E R 
UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the 
applicants and the response filed thereto,  
IT IS ORDERED that the application for stay is denied without 
prejudice to applicants again seeking relief, if necessary, once state court 
remedies are exhausted. 
 /s/  Sonia Sotomayor   
        Associate Justice of the Supreme 
   Court of the United States 
Dated this 29th 
day of September, 2026.
